LESSON: EATING HABITS AND VALUES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.1: Eating Habits and Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Eating Habits and Values. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name foods available in our brainstorming, pictures, buzz groups, 2. Why do some members of community, video clips the community avoid

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: EATING HABITS AND VALUES
This lesson teaches Eating Habits and Values for Grade 3 HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. name foods available in our brainstorming, pictures, buzz groups, 2. Why do some members of community, video clips the community avoid
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Eating Habits and Values using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Eating Habits and Values above.
2. Explain Eating Habits and Values to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Eating Habits and Values.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Eating Habits and Values with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Eating Habits and Values important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
